name: RTFKT AR Hoodie
skeleton: Jurek.Rig (shared, 92 bones) + 12 extra Cloth_ bones, 104 joints in the file

hood_up.note: hood slides from the back over the head, overshoot, cords swing and settle; ends at rest pose

hood_down.note: hood folds back onto the upper back, cords swing; ends at hood_state_down

hood_state_up.note: static pose, hood on the head (rest)

hood_state_down.note: static pose, hood resting on the back

clip_tracks: Cloth_ bones only (rotation, Hood_Base also translation): they layer on top of any body clip without overriding body bones
hair_note: hides_hair partial: hood clears the medium-LOD hair by 17-31 mm; swap to short hair or flatten Hair_Side_*/Hair_Back_* a few degrees when the hood is down is not needed, hair is free when the hood is down
print_credits: RTFKT x Nike graphics are hand redrawn approximations for a personal avatar of the owner's own hoodie
